name: labs/undalogic__usmu_py
title: uSMU source-measure unit (usmu_py.USMU)
intro: uSMU source-measure unit (usmu_py.USMU), adapted from undalogic/usmu_py. It reads `identification` and `adc_0_1`; runs `configure`, `iv_point` and `output`. `configure`: set the oversample rate and lock the current range; the native class has no query for either setting, so the applied values are returned. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/undalogic__usmu_py --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/undalogic__usmu_py --backend fake --mcp
